posts.title: Shed Skin restricted-Python-to-C++ transpiler 0.9.13
posts.description: I have just released version 0.9.13 of Shed Skin , a restricted-python to C++ transpiler. Shed Skin allows one to effectively convert (or transpile) pure Python code to highly optimized machine code. This comes at the cost though of having to conform to a seriously restricted subset of Python features/libraries. posts.title: Shed Skin restricted-Python-to-C++ compiler v0.9.11 released
posts.description: I have just released version 0.9.11 of Shed Skin, a restricted-Python-to-C++ compiler. Most importantly, it adds support for Python 3.14. It also adds support for many 3.x features that were not yet implemented, in addition to basic support for the base64 module. It also optimizes a few more common code patterns. posts.title: Shed Skin restricted-Python-to-C++ compiler 0.9.9
posts.description: I have just released version 0.9.9 of Shed Skin, a restricted-Python-to-C++ compiler. It comes with many changes under the hood to improve the code base. For example, Shakeeb has started adding type annotations to Shed Skin itself, whereas I have fixed many C++ compiler warnings.
